behavior: Record every external side effect in an idempotency ledger keyed by effect identity so a replayed or resumed workflow never performs the same external effect twice.

No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: protectedTests HAR-002 is the catalog suite covering HAR-003, HAR-004, HAR-005, HAR-006 and HAR-010 (verification/test-catalog.json); per CP-002's ruling this suite will be re-cut into per-requirement sub-suites, and this contract cites the current catalog entry pending that amendment. runnerDigest is the attested G0 runner image pending a G1 runner attestation; task-ready v1 does not verify runnerDigest or testSourceDigest. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 46c8cf99cbac5d0c87729e08db20bbadbe2bacd0, computed by calling the runner's own runnerDigests() in src/evidence.ts directly rather than invented. The ledger is scoped as a pluggable interface with an in-memory reference implementation for this task; persisting it to PostgreSQL is left to whichever of HAR-003-T01/HAR-006-T01 lands as its backing store, so no new runtime dependency or allowedPaths beyond the default agent-harness src/test globs is needed here.
